_comment: Claude Code (CLI) MCP configuration. Drop this into your project's .mcp.json (committable, project-scoped) or merge into ~/.claude.json under the 'mcpServers' key (user-scoped). You can also register interactively with: claude mcp add memograph python -- -m memograph.mcp.run_server --vault /path/to/your/vault. Replace the vault path with your actual vault directory. After saving, restart Claude Code or run /mcp to confirm the server is connected.
